item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["7b7c990d61bcf26e26ef"],"operation":"Report the XInclude context's last error during processing.","condition":"An injected allocation failure is reported during XInclude processing.","capability":"xmlXIncludeGetLastError returns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the context.","consequence":"The existing harness check aborts if the returned error differs.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns context error state after an allocation failure."},{"member_ids":["00980152d1a462c3b661"],"operation":"Route XInclude and included XML parser errors to a per-context structured error handler.","condition":"A handler is registered with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler and a qualifying error occurs while processing the context.","capability":"The XInclude context stores the handler and forwards errors to it.","consequence":"The registered handler does not receive the error.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: handler routing is distinct from the allocation-failure last-error check."}]}
